basics.name: Shourav Misro
basics.headline: Software Quality Assurance Engineer specializing in manual testing, API validation, regression testing, and Playwright automation.

about.short: Detail-oriented Software Quality Assurance Engineer with hands-on experience in manual testing, API testing, regression testing, and test automation using Playwright. Skilled in designing and executing test plans, validating REST APIs, documenting defects, and ensuring software quality throughout the SDLC using Agile methodologies.
about.long: Detail-oriented Software Quality Assurance Engineer with hands-on experience in manual testing, API testing, regression testing, and test automation using Playwright. Skilled in designing and executing test plans, validating REST APIs, documenting defects, and ensuring software quality throughout the SDLC using Agile methodologies.

projects.title: LearnLink LMS
projects.summary: Designed and executed 50+ manual test cases covering authentication, course management, enrollment, dashboard, REST API, and database workflows. Performed REST API testing using Postman, validated 500+ SQL database records, and identified 20+ defects through structured bug reporting and regression testing. Collaborated with developers on root cause analysis, defect verification, and release validation.

projects.title: Hospital Management System
projects.summary: Designed and executed functional and regression test cases for patient, appointment, record management, CRUD operations, and backend business logic. Validated input handling, data integrity, SQL-based database consistency, and workflow accuracy; reported defects related to validation and system logic.

projects.title: Root Android
projects.summary: Conducted manual, usability, and regression testing for mobile e-commerce workflows including product browsing, cart, checkout, and payment interactions. Identified UI, functional, and usability issues and validated fixes to improve application stability and user experience.

projects.title: Local Business Directory
projects.summary: Conducted functional testing and database validation for listing, search, filtering, and backend consistency across multiple user scenarios. Prepared structured test scenarios and defect reports to support product improvement and reliable feature behavior.

projects.title: Intelligent Solar Panel System
projects.summary: Abstract published at IEEE CS BDC Summer Symposium 2025. Developed a smart energy optimization system with real-time monitoring, protection, and automated control; performed system testing, data validation, sensor accuracy verification, and performance analysis.

projects.title: Unified Smart Home Ecosystem
projects.summary: Developed an ESP32 and Raspberry Pi smart home system with sensor acquisition, motion interrupts, MQTT communication, and real-time automation logic.

experience.title: QA Intern
highlights: Designed and maintained Test Plans, Test Cases, RTM, Risk Matrix, Test Data, and QA documentation for requirement-based testing.
Executed manual, API, regression, integration, and database validation testing across reward, discount, eligibility, configuration, and user workflow scenarios.
Validated business rules, REST API responses, database consistency, edge cases, and cross-module workflows to ensure software reliability.
Reported and tracked defects in Jira with detailed reproduction steps, logs, severity, priority, screenshots, and validation notes.
Developed and maintained Playwright automation scripts for regression testing of critical application workflows.
